title.zh: 查询用户在频道中实时信息
title.en: Queries the real-time information of a user in a channel

descriptions.zh:
# 使用说明
本接口用于查询用户在频道中实时信息。例如：您可以查询用户角色类型、入会时间等信息。
# QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为100次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。更多信息，请参见[QPS限制](~~341645~~)。
descriptions.en:
# Usage notes
This operation is used to query the real-time information of a user in a channel. For example, you can query information such as the user role type and the time of joining the meeting.
# QPS limit
The per-user QPS limit of this operation is 100 times per second. If the limit is exceeded, API calls will be throttled, which may affect your business. Call this operation properly. For more information, see [QPS limit](~~341645~~).
